## F5P1: Total number of sox2+ cells in lakritz mutants and wild-type siblings - actually volumes of sox2+ staining to total EdU staining
```{r, echo=FALSE}
Sox2Lak<-read.csv("/Users/cervenyk/Documents/fish data/Tectum_Hannah_Mate_collaboration/firstpass_figures for tectum paper/Figure_5_sox2/sox2_FISH.csv")
View(Sox2Lak)
```
### F5P1 Getting ready for boxplot
```{r, echo=FALSE}
Sox2Lak$dpf<-factor(Sox2Lak$dpf,
                         levels=c("5 dpf", "9 dpf"))
Sox2Lak$Genotype<-factor(Sox2Lak$Genotype,
                         levels=c("WT", "lak"))
```
#inserted later for adding pvalues/stat signif to plot
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#need to make this for manual p-values
stat_manual_sox2 <-tibble::tribble(
  ~dpf, ~group1,~group2,~p.adj,
  "5 dpf", "WT", "lak", 0.332,
  "9 dpf","WT","lak", 0.0002
) %>%
  mutate(
    dpf = factor(dpf, levels = c("5 dpf", "9 dpf")),
    p.adj.signif = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ "ns"
    ),
    y.position = 0.46   # adjust based on your beeswarm/error bar heights per facet
  )
```

```{r}
TectumF4P1_Sox2lakritz <- ggplot(Sox2Lak, aes(x= Genotype, y= RatioSox2DAPI))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+
  geom_jitter(color = "black", fill = "gray", pch=21, size = 2, alpha=0.7, width=0.3)+
  facet_wrap(~dpf, strip.position = "top", scales = "free_x")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=expression(WT, italic(lak)))+
  xlab("Genotype")+
  theme(axis.title =element_text(size = 14))+
  theme(axis.title.y = ggtext::element_markdown())+    #need this for italicized axis title
  ylab("*sox2+* volume / DAPI volume")+ 
  ylim(0.05, 0.475)+
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_manual_sox2, label = "p.adj.signif", xmin = "group1", xmax = "group2", y.position = "y.position")
  
TectumF4P1_Sox2lakritz
```
#export plot as png
```{r, echo=FALSE}
ggsave("TectumF4P1_Sox2lakritz_revised.png", TectumF4P1_Sox2lakritz, path=NULL, 
         scale = 1, width = 12, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 300, limitsize = TRUE, bg=NULL)
```

### F5P1 Statistics (ultimately to put stats on plot above)
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#Summary Statistics (n, mean, SD)
group_by(Sox2Lak, Genotype, dpf) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    count = n(),
    median = median(RatioSox2DAPI, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean = mean(RatioSox2DAPI, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(RatioSox2DAPI, na.rm = TRUE))
```
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#Specify 5 dpf
F <- Sox2Lak$dpf == "5 dpf"
Sox2Lak[F,]
#Specify 9 dpf
N <- Sox2Lak$dpf == "9 dpf"
Sox2Lak[N,]
```
Use generalized linear modeling and since these ratios are always positive can use gam
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Load required libraries
library(mgcv)
library(emmeans)

# 1. Fit the beta Regression Model
# The logit link naturally handles variance that scales with the mean
fit  <- gam(RatioSox2DAPI ~ Genotype * dpf, family = betar(link = "logit"), data = Sox2Lak)
fit0 <- gam(RatioSox2DAPI ~ 1,            family = betar(link = "logit"), data = Sox2Lak)

# 2. Check the Model Summary for Interaction Effects
summary(fit)
anova(fit0, fit, test = "F")   # overall test
AIC(fit0, fit)

# 3. Post-Hoc Comparisons
emm_sox2lak <- emmeans(fit, ~ Genotype | dpf, type = "response")
cons_sox2lak <-contrast(emm_sox2lak, "revpairwise", by = "dpf")
summary(cons_sox2lak, adjust = "holm", by = NULL)

```

## F5P2: sox2+ cells in intact and one-eyed brains 
```{r, echo=FALSE}
Sox2Innerv<-read.csv("/Users/cervenyk/Documents/fish data/Tectum_Hannah_Mate_collaboration/firstpass_figures for tectum paper/Figure_5_sox2/sox2_InnervLRcompare_FISH.csv")
View(Sox2Innerv)
```
### F5P2 stats then plot Graph
```{r, echo=FALSE}
Sox2Innerv$dpf<-factor(Sox2Innerv$dpf,
                       levels=c("7_dpf", "9_dpf"))
```
#to be consistent with first part of sox2 analysis, use GAM but this time with gaussian fit because of having + and - response variables
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# 1.run model:
fit_sox2innerv <- gam(sox2_LR_ratio ~ Innerv * dpf, 
                  family = gaussian(link = "identity"), 
                  data = Sox2Innerv)

# 2. Check the Model Summary
summary(fit_sox2innerv)
anova(gam(sox2_LR_ratio ~ 1, data = Sox2Innerv), fit_sox2innerv, test = "F")   # overall test statistic

# 3. Pairwise post-hoc tests with Bonferroni adjustment
posthoc_sox2_innerv <- emmeans(fit_sox2innerv, pairwise ~ Innerv | dpf, type = "response")
summary(posthoc_sox2_innerv$contrasts, adjust = "Holm", by = NULL)

# View the adjusted p-values
#pairwise_results_innerv$contrasts


```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
#need to make this for manual p-values
stat_manual_sox2Innerv <-tibble::tribble(
  ~dpf, ~group1,~group2,~p.adj,
  "7_dpf", "intact", "one_eyed", 0.063,
  "9_dpf","intact","one_eyed", 0.0001
) %>%
  mutate(
    dpf = factor(dpf, levels = c("7_dpf", "9_dpf")),
    p.adj.signif = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ "ns"
    ),
    y.position = 0.52   # adjust based on your beeswarm/error bar heights per facet
  )
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
TectumF4P2_sox2innervation <- ggplot(Sox2Innerv, aes(x=Innerv, y=ratio))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+
  geom_jitter(color = "black", fill = "gray", pch=21, size = 2, alpha=0.7, width=0.3)+
  facet_wrap(~dpf, strip.position = "top", scales = "free_x")+
  theme(axis.title =element_text(size = 14))+
  xlab("Innervation Status")+
  theme(axis.title.y = ggtext::element_markdown())+    #need this for italicized axis title
  ylab("ratio of *sox2+* volumes / tectal volumes")+ 
  ylim(-0.2, 0.6)+
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_manual_sox2Innerv, label = "p.adj.signif", xmin = "group1", xmax = "group2", y.position = "y.position")
  
  
print(TectumF4P2_sox2innervation)
```
